question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
gold_answer: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.
candidate_answer: The total contractual fees for the FY2021 audits were **$73,000**. [Source: OPERS External Audit RFP Q&A, p. 2](Oklahoma_OPERS__2022-03-RFP-QA-External-Audit-Services.pdf#page=2)
